title: Samsung Galaxy Watch9 in for review
description: If you have the Galaxy Watch8, then this may look familiar. The new Galaxy Watch9 is here, and it looks and feels about the same. It comes in a simple box with a USB-C magnetic charger and a band. You can get the watch in either 40mm or 44mm, and it will be on sale on August 7 in a few colors - Cream and Graphite (40mm), Graphite and Silver (44mm). Prices are €400 and €490, respectively. There isn't much in terms of upgrades, but you do get the new Snapdragon Wear Elite SoC, which should bring an overall smoother experience - faster app launches, better AI performance, and improved...

title: Honor Power3 may have aimed too high with its battery capacity
description: Honor launched the Power2 in January, and then, in May, we heard that the upcoming Power3 would have a battery capacity of 11,000 to 12,000 mAh, while the exact number wasn't decided yet. Today a new rumor from the same source is back to dial down our expectations, unfortunately. According to Digital Chat Station on Weibo, the Honor Power3 will have a battery of at least 10,000 mAh. The Power2 has a 10,080 mAh battery, so its successor may match it or surpass it every so slightly. But it seems like the aim to get to 11,000 mAh or even 12,000 mAh may have been too optimistic. Honor...

title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro pops up on Geekbench with its key specs
description: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy F70e in February, and we might see it launch a Pro model in the coming months, as the smartphone was spotted on the GSMA database a few months ago and has now popped up on Geekbench. The benchmark database reveals that the Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro, bearing model code SM-E476B, is powered by Qualcomm's SM6475 chip, which corresponds to the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 SoC. It consists of two quad-core clusters - one having a maximum clock speed of 1.8GHz and the other having a clock speed of up to 2.4GHz. GPU is likely Adreno 710. Samsung Galaxy F70e The Galaxy F70...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro will get a global launch, new rumor claims
description: Last year the Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max were launched in China and never made it outside of the company’s home country. The situation is changing this year, however, according to a new report. The Xiaomi 18 Pro at least will allegedly be released in markets like Europe, Türkiye, Russia, Taiwan, and Japan. A few days ago a different report claimed that the Xiaomi 18 Pro would also launch in India alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. Xiaomi 17 Pro Today's rumor says the Xiaomi 18 Pro won't be coming to India, so the situation is still pretty confusing. Today's report also...

title: Facebook Verified is a new free badge that confirms there's a real person behind an account
description: Today Meta is launching Facebook Verified. This is a free badge that lets you know there's a real person behind an account. To get the badge, you need to go through a selfie-based verification process. You basically record a selfie video, which the company will check against your existing profile pictures to confirm a match. The process should only take a few minutes. If you get the badge, it will initially appear in Facebook Marketplace, Dating, Groups, and on your profile. In the future, it will also be seen in Feed posts. Obviously, the badge doesn't mean that Facebook "endorses the...

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra in for review
description: The new Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra landed in our office and it's time to unbox it. The phone ships in a plain box with a (3A) USB-C cable. The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra ships in Graphite, Cream and Violet Shadow. Samsung.com’s exclusive fourth color is called Green Shadow. You can have it in 12/256GB or 12/512GB configurations; prices are €2,200 and €2,400, respectively. You shouldn't judge the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra on its specs or the way it looks on a webpage. Half of the charm of these folding phones is the way they all feel different than your regular slab phone. And the Galaxy Z...

title: After OnePlus, Nothing might be next to exit multiple global markets
description: Last week, OnePlus announced what was rumored for months: its exit from the North American and European markets. Now a new report claims Nothing will follow suit, exiting 12 "or more" global markets. This includes the Middle East, Japan, and "parts of Europe". Unfortunately, the report doesn't go into any more detail about specific countries. Nothing is also said to be reducing its workforce by 40%, while its R&D unit is facing layoffs of around 50% in China and 30-40% in London. Nothing Phone (4a) Pro Obviously, Nothing is impacted by the rising memory prices, and seems to want to...

title: More details about the Samsung Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro, and S27 Ultra leak
description: Yesterday a rumor told us that Samsung is testing a new main camera sensor for the upcoming Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+, and it also reiterated the fact that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will have a 50MP ultrawide camera. Today a new rumor confirms the 50MP ultrawide yet again, while also revealing that it's using Sony's IMX855 1/2.55-inch type sensor. The S27 Pro and S27 Ultra will also share one zoom camera, while the Ultra is now said to have two. That's a similar setup to its predecessors, but earlier rumors have claimed it would have a total of three cameras, of which only...

title: EU listings confirm shorter battery lifespan for new Galaxy foldables
description: With the Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip, Samsung turned a new chapter in its smartphone hardware history by incorporating silicon-carbon batteries for the very first time. The Fold8 Ultra in particular got a 600mAh boost over the Fold7 thanks to its higher-energy-density cell. But there is one minor downside. According to the EU’s EPREL ratings, the batteries on the new foldables are all rated at 1,200 endurance cycles. For comparison, the Z Flip7 and Z Fold7 were rated at 2,000 cycles. These values show the number of charge cycles after which the phone’s battery would be sitting at...

title: Ultrahuman overhauls its app with at-a-glance status updates and suggestions
description: Ultrahuman has been expanding its ecosystem of health tracking tech with the recent launch of the Ultrahuman Ring Pro and the Ultrahuman Photon (a red light therapy device). To make the experience even better, the stat tracking more accurate and the insights more helpful, the company has completely overhauled its app with the Ultrahuman Emerald update. This update adds the Ultra-Sphere to the app, which is a sort of digital mood ring – an orb that changes color to give you instant feedback on how you are doing. A deep green means you are thriving, while amber suggests that you slow down...

title: WhatsApp update brings account creation on the iPad
description: WhatsApp is rolling out four new features for its users, with an especially big update for iPad users. Now, you can create a WhatsApp account directly on an iPad without having to first have it linked to a phone. You can register directly on the iPad, set up the account, and start using it without a phone. This should make a big improvement to the usability of the app on the iPad, since it debuted last year. WhatsApp has also updated the experience in your car. Now, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto can hear and respond to messages, make calls, see their call history, and reach...

title: Honor's MagicOS 11 early access program is now open for Magic V6
description: Honor has opened the MagicOS 11 early access program for the Magic V6 in China, which was launched in March with Android 16-based MagicOS 10. If you are interested in trying the MagicOS 11 on your Magic V6, you can sign up for the early access program by opening the My Honor app on your smartphone and navigating to the Club section. After that, select MagicOS, click on the “MagicOS 11 Liquid Glass Early Access Pioneer Recruitment” banner, and follow the on-screen instructions. Now fill out the application with correct details and click the "Submit" button. But before you do all of...

title: Geekbench 7 arrives with updated workflows, redesigned multi-core tests
description: Primate Labs has officially released its latest cross-platform benchmarking app – Geekbench 7. The new version brings updated workload tests alongside redesigned benchmarking across the multi-core CPU and GPU departments. On the CPU side, Geekbench 7 features new media workloads for audio and video encoding, decoding, and processing. These tests better reflect regular use cases like video calls, screen sharing, and content consumption. For gaming, Geekbench 7 brings a new Game Physics workload built on the Jolt Physics engine. The Photo Editor workload now features “a richer set of...

title: iQOO Z11 Lite debuts with 6,500mAh battery and Dimensity 6300 SoC
description: iQOO has officially launched the Z11 Lite in India after revealing nearly every aspect of the smartphone ahead of its debut, leaving only the pricing under wraps. The iQOO Z11 Lite is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with up to 6GB of RAM and up to 256GB of onboard storage. The handset also includes a microSD card slot for further storage expansion. Up front, it features a 6.74-inch HD+ LCD display with a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 1,200 nits of peak brightness. For photography, the phone gets a 50MP Sony IMX852 primary camera, accompanied by a 0.08MP...

title: Lava Virat V1 and Virat V1 5G arrive with sub-Rs.15,000 ($155) price tags
description: Lava announced its partnership with Flipkart earlier this month for its new Virat smartphone series, built for the youth and online-first buyers. And as promised, the Indian handset maker today launched the Virat V1 and Virat V1 5G as the first smartphones under the Virat series with sub-INR15,000 ($155/€135) price tags. Lava Virat V1 5G Let's talk about the Lava Virat V1 5G first. It's powered by the Unisoc T8200 SoC, paired with 4GB of RAM. The smartphone has 64GB of storage onboard, which is expandable up to 1TB via a microSD card. In terms of software, the Lava Virat V1 5G runs...

title: Oppo A7 Pro Max might have just run Geekbench, confirming its SoC and RAM amount
description: A few days ago, we heard about the upcoming Oppo A7 Pro Max supposedly having a 10,000 mAh battery. Now an Oppo phone with the model number PYC110 has been spotted in the Geekbench online results database. This is rumored to be the A7 Pro Max. As you can see in the screenshot below, it managed a single-core score of 976 and a multi-core score of 2,250 in Geekbench 6.7.1. The benchmark listing reveals that it's powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset, which in the prototype that ran the benchmark was paired with 12GB of RAM. The Oppo A7 Pro Max is expected to launch running Android...

title: Oppo K15 is official with an active-cooling fan, 8,000mAh battery
description: The Oppo K15 has been quietly unveiled in China, joining the K15 Pro and K15 Pro+, which debuted in April. The standard K15 retains the same design language as its Pro siblings and also features a built-in active cooling fan. It is already available for purchase in China and is being offered in a sole 12GB/256GB variant, which is priced at CNY 2,299 ($340). The handset sports a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, 1,200 nits peak brightness, and 1.5K resolution. It also comes with an in-display fingerprint scanner. At the back, the Oppo K15 features a dual-rear...

title: You can now log into your Google account with a selfie video
description: Google is now letting you log into your account with a selfie video. You of course first need to set this up, by recording an initial selfie video, in which you just look at your device's camera and complete "a few short, guided head movements to capture multiple angles", the company says. After that, you can log into your Google account with a selfie video, for example if you've forgotten your password. Google will compare the new selfie video with the one you recorded when you set up the feature and let you in. You can delete the saved selfie video at any time from your...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 and S27+ could get a new main camera
description: The Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ are now said to be in testing with a new 50MP main camera using a Sony sensor. This is notable because Samsung makes camera sensors itself, and obviously likes to use them in its own phones. Testing a new sensor this early in the development cycle does not guarantee that it will actually be used, but it's an interesting development nonetheless. The S27 and S27+ are expected to be using the same 12MP ultrawide camera that is in the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+. On the other hand, the S27 Pro and S27 Ultra will apparently be getting a new 50MP...

title: Honor and Arri will showcase the Robot Phone next week, Honor unveils a new logo
description: The Honor Robot Phone may arrive earlier than expected – Honor announced an “Imaging Technology Launch Event” for July 28 (that’s Tuesday next week). Honor, along with partner Arri, will present a phone that “packs a full-stack cinematic workflow”. Honor and Arri will hold an Imaging Technology Launch Event on the 28th They are really leaning into the phone’s video skills. If you watched the FIFA World Cup 2026 final, you may have spotted the Robot Phone. It also made an appearance at the Shanghai International Film Festival.
